On the real-world datasets, we use perplexity and normalized pointwise mutual information (NPMI) as the evaluation metrics. ... We propose topic words recovery accuracy (or "recovery accuracy" in short) to evaluate the model performance on synthetic datasets.

On the real-world datasets, we use perplexity and normalized pointwise mutual information (NPMI) as the evaluation metrics. On synthetic datasets, we propose topic words recovery accuracy (or "recovery accuracy" in short) to evaluate the model performance.
